favorite_game_part1: World of Dota is a custom game on everyone's favorite game
favorite_game_part2: . We took the best elements from Dota 2 and added unique mechanics to create unforgettable moments for players. If you love strategy and team games, World of Dota is for you! Try new tactics and builds, explore fresh opportunities, and prove your skills in World of Dota. Are you ready to step into battle and become a legend?
ranked_matches_description: Compete against other players, increase your rank, and become a champion by playing solo or in duo.
arena_mode_description: Want to play solo or in a team, farming creeps? Then the “Arena” mode is perfect for you! In this mode, you'll farm waves of creeps, aiming for a spot at the top.
unique_talents_description1: Each hero has special talents, and some possess unique abilities not found in
unique_talents_description2: . Moreover, the game contains custom characters that are completely absent from the original! This opens up endless possibilities for tactics and new playstyles, making each battle truly unique.
strength_tournaments_description: Take part in regular tournaments, compete with the strongest, and win prizes. Show off your skills in solo and team competitions!
who_choose_description: In the World of Dota universe (based on Dota 2), there are many diverse heroes, each with unique abilities and playstyles. The playstyle can change depending on how you choose to upgrade talents and which items you select for your hero. This allows players to adapt their hero to their strategy or the needs of the team, making every match unique and unpredictable.
prize_pool: Prize pool: 20000 RUB + 124000 Coins + 2 New Exclusive Effects.
attribute_description_strength: Each point of Strength grants 22 health and 0.09 health regen.
attribute_description_agility: Each point of agility grants 1 attack speed and 0.16 armor.
attribute_description_intelligence: Each point of intelligence grants 12 mana, 0.05 mana regen, and 0.1% magic resistance.
health_regen_description: Health determines how much damage a hero can take before dying. Each point of strength increases a hero's max health and health regen.
mana_regen_description: Mana determines how many abilities a hero can use. Each point of intelligence increases a hero's max mana and mana regen.
